main.description: Retires an automation account, for CI an organization no longer runs or a token that leaked: its token stops working, and the registry gives it no other. Its repository and its name stay, since its attestations count toward the releases it published. The caller must be an admin of the account's organization. Retiring one that was retired changes nothing.

account.description: The automation account, which this registry holds.

errors.name: AccountInUse
errors.description: A package's maintainers or a team still names the account; the message names them.
